items.summary: The Carney government has yet to announce any actions in response to what it calls a “binding” ruling by the UN’s top court last week that Myanmar perpetrated a genocide against its Rohingya minority.

items.title: Ending homelessness will be 'very challenging,' Ontario Premier Doug Ford says
items.summary: Ending homelessness in 10 years will be “very challenging,” Ontario Premier Doug Ford said Tuesday.
